description: This file defines the Converters class, which acts as a factory and registry for various Converter instances used within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving, registering, and loading converters, as well as inner classes implementing specific converter behaviors, such as a pass-through converter.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods and inner classes for managing conversion objects within the framework.

classes.name: Converters.PassThruConverterCreator
classes.description: Inner class implementing ConverterCreator that creates pass-through converters when source and target classes are compatible.

classes.name: Converters.PassThruConverter
classes.description: Inner class implementing Converter that performs a no-op conversion, returning the source object when source and target types are the same.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Retrieves a Converter instance suitable for converting from sourceClass to targetClass, or throws ClassNotFoundException if none is available.

methods.name: loadContainedConverters
methods.description: Loads all Converter classes contained within the specified container class.

methods.name: registerCreator
methods.description: Registers a ConverterCreator instance to be used when direct converters are not found.

methods.name: registerConverter
methods.description: Registers a specific Converter instance for use within the conversion framework.
